verdict.rationale: The evidence shows llama.cpp exposes some low-level engine knobs: users set N_GPU_LAYERS (llama-cpp-comm-9) and choose how a model splits across CPU and GPU (llama-cpp-gh-10, llama-cpp-comm-11). mmap appears only as an internal loading change (llama-cpp-comm-1), not as a setting users can override. missing for 10: documented flags to toggle mmap or enable memory locking (mlock), first-party docs listing engine/server tuning options, and hands-on confirmation that these overrides work.
